base_member_text: L911/L927 and L1258/L1279: in the C17 and C21 blocks 'elseif( NPFORT >= 1 )' precedes 'elseif( NPFORT == 2 )', making the ==2 branch unreachable; C18/C19/C20 use '== 1' (L989, L1079, L1168) so their ==2 branches are reachable - asymmetric treatment of NPFORT=2.
audit_member_text: C17 mode selection is internally shadowed: `elseif (NPFORT >= 1)` at L911 consumes NPFORT=2, so the five-field PFX2 read at L927-L936 is unreachable; the same ordering at L947 and L956 makes the mode-2 PFX2 broadcast unreachable. North boundary repeats the shadow at L1258 versus L1279. Consequently mode-2 interpolation later reads PFX2 at L1018/L1109/L1198/L1288 without this file's intended population path.
dispositions.rationale: NPFORT>=1 ordered before ==2 makes mode-2 PFX2 read/broadcast unreachable (C17/C21)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L4106/L4147-L4153: the spatially-constant else branch of the TOXPARB (bed partition) block assigns TOXPARW, not TOXPARB (L4151), duplicating the water-column branch @L4093-L4099; TOXPARB never receives the constant fill.
audit_member_text: PARTITIONB's spatially constant else branch L4147-L4153 writes `TOXPARW` instead of `TOXPARB`, leaving the bed array unexpanded while overwriting the water-column array.
dispositions.rationale: PARTITIONB constant else branch writes TOXPARW, leaving bed TOXPARB unfilled
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L4847-L4853: DYE.INP ISALTYP==0 branch loops 'do L = LG,LA_Global' (L4850) using stale LG as lower bound and reads into fixed DYE_Global(LG,K,MD) while loop variable L is unused - inconsistent with SALT (L4758) and TEMP (L4807) analogues which loop 'do LG = 2,LA_Global'.
audit_member_text: DYE sequential format loops `do L=LG,LA_Global` at L4850 but stores every record into `DYE_Global(LG,...)` at L4851; LG is not assigned in that branch and the loop variable L is unused.
dispositions.rationale: DYE.INP loop do L=LG,LA_Global stores DYE_Global(LG,...) with stale LG, L unused
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L5153-L5156: TOXB.INP 'fill any missing layers' loop runs after the per-cell read loop but indexes TOXB_Global(LG,...) with the last value of LG only, so only one cell is filled; contrast per-cell fill in DOCB (L4329-4331).
audit_member_text: TOXB missing-layer fill L5153-L5156 is outside the global-cell loop, so it fills only the final LG's layers KBINPUT+1:KB rather than every cell.
dispositions.rationale: TOXB missing-layer fill outside cell loop — fills only final LG
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L7001-L7066: for ISICE==1 the ISER.INP series are read on master (L7004-7035) but the Broadcast block (L7057-7065) sits inside the 'elseif( ISICE == 2 )' branch, so ISER data appear not to be broadcast to other ranks in this file.
audit_member_text: ISICE=1 series are read only on master L7001-L7035, while MITLAST/TSICE broadcasts L7057-L7065 are inside the `elseif(ISICE==2)` branch; no ISICE=1 broadcast is visible.

base_member_text: L7262/L7286/L7310/L7313: in the MHK block, 'endif' at L7286 closes 'if( NFLAGPWR == 1 )' so 'elseif( NFLAGPWR == 2 )' (L7310) and 'elseif( NFLAGPWR == 3 )' (L7313) chain to 'if( process_id == master_id )' (L7262); consequently the NFLAGPWR==1 broadcasts (L7288-L7308) execute only on the master rank and the ==2/==3 branches execute only on non-master ranks.
audit_member_text: MHK nesting pairs `elseif(NFLAGPWR==2/3)` L7310/L7313 with `if(process_id==master_id)` L7262, not with the already-ended inner flag-1 test L7264-L7286. Flag-1 collective broadcasts L7288-L7308 therefore execute only on master; flag-3 is entered only by non-master ranks and its nested master read L7314 cannot execute. Flag-3 also reads one stale-M element at L7315 without a class loop. The final cell check L7364-L7370 uses scalar DIAMMHK last computed only in master paths.
dispositions.rationale: MHK NFLAGPWR nesting pairs elseif 2/3 with master test; flag-1 broadcasts master-only
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L4576: FPOCB.INP IREAD==2/ISALTYP/=0 branch uses implied-DO stride NS: (STFPOCB(L,K,NS),K = 1,KBINPUT,NS) - stride is the sediment-class index, inconsistent with stride-1 at L4568.
L4414: 'STPOCB(L,K) = 0.0' executes outside any L/K loop (right after broadcasts @L4409-4411), zeroing a single element addressed by stale loop indices; probably intended STPOCB = 0.0 (whole array).
L4460: inside the POCB.INP IREAD==1/else branch, STDOCB(:,:) = 0.0 is zeroed (not STPOCB) before reading STPOCB values - likely copy-paste from the DOCB block @L4315.
audit_member_text: POCB executes `STPOCB(L,K)=0.0` at L4414 before this block establishes L/K loops, and several IREAD formats L4416-L4456/L4484-L4507 read unit 1 on every rank although only master opened it L4402-L4406. L4460 clears `STDOCB` in the POCB branch. FPOCB IREAD=2 alternative format uses NS as implied-do stride at L4576. FOCB closes unit 1 on master at L4653 and closes it again on all ranks at L4670.
dispositions.rationale: COMPOSITE many-to-one: B11 bundles STPOCB(L,K)=0.0 outside loop (A8), STDOCB cleared in POCB branch (A15), FPOCB NS implied-do stride (A4)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)
